versions.rationale: One unpublished patch bump for changed package contents.

changes: Trace the client wrapper to effective read options and operation boundaries.
Attribute partition-test results to effective membership, connected sets and contacted endpoints; automatic failover is not minority-side progress.
Replace the incorrect unconditional claim that two keys written together are independent decisions with the actual transaction/read boundary.
Add an incomplete-write counterexample where majority reads return new then old.
Use effective membership/roles and per-domain surviving sets.
Make three-voter placement assumptions explicit and replace unconditional fast-read/write labels with response counts.

preservedCapabilities: Joint and transitional membership, learner promotion and recovery

technicalFindings.finding: Old wording treated two keys written together as always two independent decisions.
technicalFindings.correction: Per-key intersection alone supplies no multi-key atomicity, but etcd 3.6 Txn already provides an atomic operation. Separate reads can still straddle an atomic update.

technicalFindings.finding: The generic R+W caveat lacked a concrete incomplete-write history that could be inspected.
technicalFindings.correction: Show N=3, R=W=2, a write reaching only A, then reads A/B=new and B/C=old, with X finishing before Y starts.
technicalFindings.support: ABD section 4 explains why a read must propagate its selected version under that protocol.

technicalFindings.finding: Fault-test interpretation did not explicitly bind successful probes to the partition/endpoints actually serving them.
technicalFindings.correction: Record endpoints and surviving sets, accounting for failover and a quorum retained on another side.

# Quorum review
Status: preliminary
Claim: Five configured processes across three AZs tolerate loss of any one AZ.
Assumptions: surviving voters communicate and retain required durable state. Recovery latency has not been measured.
